svg.aria-label: Title screen: Prajakta Jadhav. Tonight's tech trivia, typed out one at a time: Robot is Czech for forced labour. They've held a grudge since. The first hard drive weighed a tonne. It stored 5 whole MB. QWERTY is older than the light bulb. Tech's oldest legacy code. Git tracked its own code within days. A committed relationship. A CAPTCHA is a Turing test where the robot is the judge. The first .com (1985) is still online. Better uptime than me. Press Start.
